D2_neg02_mechanism_relabeling.observed_mechanism: GNU ar rcs packages raw bytes into an archive without validating ELF headers. GNU ld inspects member ELF headers and silently skips non-ELF archive members rather than throwing a malformed format abort. Linkage subsequently fails with non-zero exit code due to unresolved undefined references (curl_url, curl_url_set, etc.).
